## The one rule

**Edit `src/`, then build.** `ui.html` and `dist/preview.html` are generated by `tools/build.py`. Never edit them by hand; the next build overwrites them.

## Folder map

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `manifest.json` | The plugin's manifest. Ask before changing it. |
| `code.js` | The plugin's main thread: selection, insert, refresh. |
| `ui.html` | **Generated.** What Figma loads: everything inlined, no network. |
| `src/ui.html` | The panel: markup, CSS and app JavaScript. |
| `src/shaders/*.glsl` | Device, backdrop, card and other shaders, inlined at build time. |
| `src/assets/` | Base64 and JSON assets: keyboard legends, Photoreal renders and their placement. |
| `VERSION` | The build version shown in the panel, for example 3.15. |
| `vendor/three.min.js` | Three.js r149 UMD, pinned, inlined into `ui.html`. Ask before adding to `vendor/`. |
| `reference/v2/*.glsl` | V2's shipping shaders, verbatim. The calibration source of truth and the parity harness's baseline. |
| `reference/photoreal/` | The Photoreal source renders, as supplied (green screens). |
| `tools/build.py` | `src` to `ui.html` and `dist/preview.html`; `--check`; `--package`. |
| `tools/verify.js` | Parity harness against V2's shaders. |
| `tools/render.js` | Dev renderer: frames, close-ups, four-channel PNG diff. |
| `tools/port_v2_shaders.py` | `reference/v2` to `src/shaders` (phone, phone17, tablet, laptop). |
| `tools/photoreal_assets.py` | `reference/photoreal` to `src/assets` (keys the screen). |
| `docs/HANDOFF.md` | Current state, version history, open items, pitfalls. |
| `docs/PARITY.md` | Every V2 Studio feature and where V3 keeps it. |
| `.claude/skills/klinos-v3/` | The rulebook: render pipeline, material, lighting, geometry, Figma constraints. |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Working agreements. |
| `dist/` | **Generated** `preview.html`, the packaged zips, and reference screenshots. |

## Generated files

| File | Made by | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ui.html` | `python3 tools/build.py` | Three.js and shaders inlined; no network. |
| `dist/preview.html` | `python3 tools/build.py` | Three.js from unpkg; runs in a browser. |
| `dist/klinos-v3-<n>.zip` | `python3 tools/build.py --package` | Holds `manifest.json`, `code.js` and `ui.html`. |
| `src/shaders/phone.glsl`, `phone17.glsl`, `tablet.glsl`, `laptop.glsl`, `backdrop.glsl` | `tools/port_v2_shaders.py` | Edit the port script, not these files. |
| `src/assets/pr_*.b64`, `photoreal.json` | `tools/photoreal_assets.py` | |

`galaxy.glsl` is hand-written (the S26 has no V2 version). `build.py` checks that the functions it shares with `phone17.glsl` haven't drifted.

> **Warning**
> Don't move files between `src/` and `tools/` without asking first.
